title: Backend Engineer
tagline: Contracts, conventions, and correctness for services and APIs.
description: Use agents to design and build services that hold up: contracts before code, house conventions in context, failure paths specified, and every change verified.

sections.title: Design
sections.description: Agree the contract and the plan.

nodes.title: Errors are part of the contract
nodes.summary: Ask agents to specify failure behaviour as carefully as the happy path: which errors are possible, which status codes they map to, and what the client sees. Unspecified error handling is where agent-written services break.
points: Ask for the error cases before the implementation.
Map each error to a status code and a response shape.
Require validation and idempotency rules to be stated explicitly.
Make tests cover at least one failure path per endpoint.

sections.title: Build
sections.description: Conventions and tests drive the implementation.
